title: Apply one translation sign convention
description: Document and implement one coordinate/sign convention for whole-sheet translation across calibration marks, label preview scenes, and final PDF content, using software fixtures only while physical derivation remains blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: One documented origin, axis direction, and positive/negative x/y meaning is shared by all render paths
Positive and negative software fixtures move calibration marks and label scene coordinates identically
Parsed PDF coordinates agree with the shared scene after millimetre-to-point boundary conversion
Applying translation requires a compatible gated profile; fixture transforms cannot authorize calibrated output

steps.details: Define origin, x/y axis direction, translation order, page relationship, and millimetre-to-point conversion at the renderer boundary.
Apply the narrow TASK-106 translation at the framework-neutral scene root shared by calibration and final content.
Require a compatible profile and successful physical gate before production use; allow isolated software fixtures only in tests.
Compare positive, negative, and zero fixture coordinates across calibration scenes, label previews, and parsed PDF operators.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add one transform and three small coordinate fixtures.
BLOCKED: tests may prove software sign consistency but cannot prove physical correction or ink placement.
PDF points appear only at the renderer boundary.
